metadata.question: Was the rainfall in Seattle between September through November in 2021 larger than that in 2020 and in 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) for rainfall data - Location: Seattle, WA (~47.6062°N, -122.3321°W) - Time periods: Sep-Nov 2019, Sep-Nov 2020, Sep-Nov 2021 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS provides precipitation estimates, no cloud masking needed - Just sum the total rainfall for each period 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist (C2) - Check if results are None/NaN (C3) - If 2021 > 2020 AND 2021 > 2019, answer A - Otherwise answer B ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]) # 2. Data Acquisition & Check chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') # Get collections for each year col_2019 = chirps.filterDate('2019-09-01', '2019-12-01').filterBounds(seattle) col_2020 = chirps.filterDate('2020-09-01', '2020-12-01').filterBounds(seattle) col_2021 = chirps.filterDate('2021-09-01', '2021-12-01').filterBounds(seattle) size_2019 = col_2019.size().getInfo() size_2020 = col_2020.size().getInfo() size_2021 = col_2021.size().getInfo() print(f"2019 Images: {size_2019}") print(f"2020 Images: {size_2020}") print(f"2021 Images: {size_2021}") if size_2019 == 0 or size_2020 == 0 or size_2021 == 0: print("Missing data for one or more years.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Sum precipitation for each period sum_2019 = col_2019.select('precipitation').sum() sum_2020 = col_2020.select('precipitation').sum() sum_2021 = col_2021.select('precipitation').sum() # 4. Calculation params = { 'reducer': ee.Reducer.mean(), 'geometry': seattle, 'scale': 5566, 'maxPixels': 1e9 } # Get pixel counts count_2019 = sum_2019.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=seattle, scale=5566).get('precipitation').getInfo() count_2020 = sum_2020.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=seattle, scale=5566).get('precipitation').getInfo() count_2021 = sum_2021.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=seattle, scale=5566).get('precipitation').getInfo() if count_2019 == 0 or count_2020 == 0 or count_2021 == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") else: rain_2019 = sum_2019.reduceRegion(**params).get('precipitation').getInfo() rain_2020 = sum_2020.reduceRegion(**params).get('precipitation').getInfo() rain_2021 = sum_2021.reduceRegion(**params).get('precipitation').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Final Answer print(f"2019 Total Rainfall: {rain_2019:.2f} mm") print(f"2020 Total Rainfall: {rain_2020:.2f} mm") print(f"2021 Total Rainfall: {rain_2021:.2f} mm") if rain_2019 is None or rain_2020 is None or rain_2021 is None: print("Calculation failed - None values.") print("C3") elif rain_2019 < 0 or rain_2020 < 0 or rain_2021 < 0: print("Invalid negative rainfall values.") print("C3") elif rain_2021 > rain_2020 and rain_2021 > rain_2019: print("2021 rainfall was larger than both 2020 and 2019.") print("A") else: print("2021 rainfall was NOT larger than both 2020 and 2019.") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062])

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')

# Get collections for each year
col_2019 = chirps.filterDate('2019-09-01', '2019-12-01').filterBounds(seattle)
col_2020 = chirps.filterDate('2020-09-01', '2020-12-01').filterBounds(seattle)
col_2021 = chirps.filterDate('2021-09-01', '2021-12-01').filterBounds(seattle)

size_2019 = col_2019.size().getInfo()
size_2020 = col_2020.size().getInfo()
size_2021 = col_2021.size().getInfo()

print(f"2019 Images: {size_2019}")
print(f"2020 Images: {size_2020}")
print(f"2021 Images: {size_2021}")

if size_2019 == 0 or size_2020 == 0 or size_2021 == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or more years.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Sum precipitation for each period
    sum_2019 = col_2019.select('precipitation').sum()
    sum_2020 = col_2020.select('precipitation').sum()
    sum_2021 = col_2021.select('precipitation').sum()
    
    # 4. Calculation
    params = {
        'reducer': ee.Reducer.mean(),
        'geometry': seattle,
        'scale': 5566,
        'maxPixels': 1e9
    }
    
    # Get pixel counts
    count_2019 = sum_2019.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=seattle, scale=5566).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    count_2020 = sum_2020.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=seattle, scale=5566).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    count_2021 = sum_2021.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=seattle, scale=5566).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    if count_2019 == 0 or count_2020 == 0 or count_2021 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        rain_2019 = sum_2019.reduceRegion(**params).get('precipitation').getInfo()
        rain_2020 = sum_2020.reduceRegion(**params).get('precipitation').getInfo()
        rain_2021 = sum_2021.reduceRegion(**params).get('precipitation').getInfo()
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        print(f"2019 Total Rainfall: {rain_2019:.2f} mm")
        print(f"2020 Total Rainfall: {rain_2020:.2f} mm")
        print(f"2021 Total Rainfall: {rain_2021:.2f} mm")
        
        if rain_2019 is None or rain_2020 is None or rain_2021 is None:
            print("Calculation failed - None values.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif rain_2019 < 0 or rain_2020 < 0 or rain_2021 < 0:
            print("Invalid negative rainfall values.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif rain_2021 > rain_2020 and rain_2021 > rain_2019:
            print("2021 rainfall was larger than both 2020 and 2019.")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("2021 rainfall was NOT larger than both 2020 and 2019.")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
